profile.headline: Web Developer at Greenleaf Media
profile.summary: Edward Kim is a software engineer who builds complex web applications and e-commerce platforms across diverse industries. He enjoys creating effective, user-friendly solutions and collaborating with teams to deliver high-quality projects efficiently.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Built and maintained user-centered digital products for diverse clients, from content-driven websites to custom web applications, delivering reliable, high-performance solutions that aligned with business objectives.

• Led development of custom WordPress platforms and Laravel/Vue applications, defining architecture and translating business requirements into scalable solutions that improved performance and reduced production issues.
• Engineered accessible, responsive UX/UI from designs, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and WCAG guidelines to enhance user engagement across all devices.
• Established development standards for code quality, performance, and accessibility, creating consistent workflows that accelerated delivery and minimized technical debt.
• Collaborated cross-functionally with design and project teams to scope requirements, guide technical execution, and adapt solutions while meeting project timelines.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the development and modernization of critical web applications serving the entire university community, directly enhancing the digital experience for thousands of faculty members and students.

• Architected and rebuilt legacy web applications using modern frameworks (Angular, Vue) to improve performance, usability, and accessibility
• Developed scalable web applications and RESTful APIs leveraging Laravel, and ReactPHP to support mission-critical university operations
• Implemented seamless integrations with enterprise API services, primarily Mulesoft, enabling efficient data exchange across campus systems
• Maintained and optimized existing applications to ensure high availability and reliability for the university community

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Delivered end-to-end web solutions for diverse clients, from individual entrepreneurs to established organizations, helping them enhance their digital presence and streamline business operations through innovative technology.

• Designed and developed custom web applications and responsive websites that provided seamless user experiences across all devices, ensuring optimal accessibility and engagement
• Engineered complex system integrations connecting ERP/CRM platforms with e-commerce websites using C#, automating workflows and improving operational efficiency for clients
• Built scalable web applications using PHP frameworks and modern front-end technologies, tailored to meet specific client business requirements
• Collaborated directly with clients from discovery through deployment, translating business needs into technical solutions that drove measurable results
